name: Infectious Disease & Pathogenesis
summary: How bacteria, viruses, fungi and parasites cause disease, how the host fights back and how infections are diagnosed and treated.

topics.name: Koch's postulates and molecular Koch's postulates
Bacterial virulence factors: adhesins, toxins and secretion systems
Major bacterial pathogens: tuberculosis, cholera, staphylococci and streptococci
Parasitology: malaria, helminths and protozoan parasites
Diagnosis of infectious disease: culture, serology, PCR and sequencing
Antibiotics: mechanisms, resistance and new strategies
